archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grounded 2 expands the woodpile area with Rot and Ruin

entries.headline: Grounded 2 expands the woodpile area with Rot and Ruin
entries.summary: The Rot and Ruin update adds a woodpile area, a termite faction and a centipede boss, alongside a potato beetle mount and a building-painting tool.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire published the announcement at 03:00 Beijing time on October 21.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 opens DMZ ahead of launch
entries.summary: The new DMZ extraction mode is available ahead of the worldwide October 23 release. Players gather resources and extract on the Hajin map.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire published the announcement at 01:00 Beijing time on October 21; the worldwide release date is October 23.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy Resonance details its Visions companion system
entries.summary: A PlayStation Blog hands-on preview explains Visions: characters from earlier games can support the party, providing combat skills and permanent increases to base attributes.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog published the preview at 21:30 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Fountains launches its Gauntlet update
entries.summary: Gauntlet chains together 10 boss fights. Owners of the expansion named 破碎之形 can also challenge its corresponding variants; the update is now available on Xbox as well.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire confirmed the update was live at 04:00 Beijing time on October 21.

entries.headline: Palworld announces the Side by Side winter update
entries.summary: Pocketpair announced that Side by Side will arrive in winter 2026. Released material shows silhouettes of the top three characters in a poll, while specific gameplay details have not yet been announced.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON reported the news at 07:52 Beijing time on October 21; the original announcement was dated October 20.

entries.headline: Shrek 2 Remastered sets a November 10 release date
entries.summary: Aspyr's remastered cooperative action game arrives on Xbox Series X|S on November 10, with upgraded visuals, new features and classic playable characters.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: IGN reported the news at 02:24 Beijing time on October 21.

entries.headline: Keelblade releases a new demo on Steam
entries.summary: A new demo of the pirate open-world action RPG is available, supporting solo play and online co-op for up to 6 players, with island exploration, combat, sailing and crafting.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON reported the news at 15:35 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: SLAM TANK launches its Steam demo
entries.summary: A PC demo is available for this tank action game that does not center on firing shells. Players fight by ramming and swinging the turret, and can compete on online leaderboards.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON reported the news at 14:52 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Culdcept Begins schedules its PC release for October 28
entries.summary: Neos confirmed an October 28 PC release, adding 3 battle maps and other content to the earlier console versions.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 14:14 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix
entries.summary: The new anime collaboration between CD Projekt Red and TRIGGER arrived on Netflix on October 20. An accompanying game update is planned for October 22 on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 19:39 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Dumpster Gang announces December 3 launch and releases a demo
entries.summary: The raccoon action game for up to 4 players in co-op will launch on December 3. Its Steam demo is available now.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 19:06 Beijing time on October 20; the release-date announcement was dated October 19.

entries.headline: いかさまこいこい launches on Steam
entries.summary: Developer 夜更堂 has released this single-player hanafuda koi-koi roguelite. Players watch their opponent's movements and combine techniques and items to win.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 17:09 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Hela: Of Mice and Magic releases a PC demo
entries.summary: The demo features a dedicated map and story different from the full game, with local co-op as players become little mice exploring a Nordic-inspired forest.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 15:54 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Loftia makes its demo available
entries.summary: The multiplayer life-simulation game now has a demo in which friends can farm and build on floating islands. Early access is planned for November 4.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 19:53 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: うめしわ 〜定時で帰りたい365日〜 launches on mobile platforms
entries.summary: SNAPLACE has released this workplace-themed minigame adventure, featuring 100 minigames about leaving work on time, unread emails, leave requests and other everyday situations.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.

entries.headline: 本と鍵の季節 includes its full first chapter in the Steam demo
entries.summary: Shueisha Games has released a demo of the adventure game adapted from Honobu Yonezawa's novel. It includes the entire first chapter, "913", letting players take part in solving the mystery.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer reported the news at 11:58 Beijing time on October 20.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4: Infinity Ward explains the return of DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
entries.summary: In an interview, multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot looks back at the previous DMZ beta and explains why the team is attempting an extraction-shooter mode again.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: IGN published the interview at 01:00 Beijing time on October 21.

entries.headline: 復興しよう！温泉町 begins early access on December 7
entries.summary: The rural life-simulation game will enter Steam early access on December 7, and a new demo is already available. The story alternates between two protagonists: the girl 杏子 and the mayor of the hot-spring town.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON reported the news at 13:01 Beijing time on October 20.
entries.releaseTypeLabel: Early access date announcement and demo

entries.headline: ARC Raiders PvE test records more than 30 million sessions
entries.summary: Nexon and Embark said the PvE matchmaking test held from October 13 to 20 recorded more than 30 million play sessions. Player feedback was divided; the team will analyze the data before deciding what comes next.
entries.verification: The subject, core facts and publication time were checked against opened sources in the packet; no facts outside the packet were added.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON reported the news at 09:48 Beijing time on October 21.

entries.headline: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve adjusts late-game enemy flares in October 23 update
entries.summary: Ver.1.01.002 will fix several mission-progression issues and adjust the flare-use limit for the unit named 影22部队 in MISSION 28. The report discusses a late-game mission.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Bandai Namco's October 20 patch notes. The update date, version number and changes are confined to the packet evidence.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 18:04 Beijing time on October 20; the update is scheduled for October 23.
